title.narrative: Market launch of an high quality and energy efficient electric injera stove in Ethiopia

description.narrative: Ethiopia is a country of rapid economic growth. Electricity generation and access is growing fast and is mostly generated from renewable resources. In its last 5 years plan, the Ethiopian government aims to invest 20 billion dollar to reach 99% electricity coverage. At the same time, the country experiences rapid deforestation. Over half of the energy consumption in Ethiopia is used for injera baking (the national staple food). In the cities this is largely done with electricity and in rural areas wood is used. Large electrification programs aim to make electricity more accessible. Currently polluting and expensive wood fuel is being used and to a smaller extend electricity in a wasteful manner with inefficient, low quality stoves. Plates and stoves often break because they are being made of the lower quality materials available to producers. Dutch company Magic Ventures B.V. and local Ethiopian partner ET Solar Tech PLC are developing a clean, highly efficient electric cookstove that brings European standards to the Ethiopian kitchen at an affordable price called the Enat Mitad. Enat stands for the Ethiopian word Mother. Mitad is the traditional plate for baking injera. The stove uses 50-80% less energy (and thus saves money), has zero emissions and is made of high quality materials. The Enat Mitad contributes to the reforestation challenge, combatting climate change and the social and economic development of Ethiopians. To prepare for future investments, Technical Assistance (DGGF-TA) is provided. The project is currently ongoing and includes further developing the prototype to meet local requirements, energy-efficiency tests, assessing and developing the supply chain to meet international standards, partner selection, preparing for market introduction and the development of a bankable business plan to attract investors. Upon successful completion of the TA further investments will be prepared and will hopefully result in the support of 25 new direct jobs, 50 indirect jobs with suppliers and improved practices and prosperity of at least 1000 formal and informal bakeries. Furthermore Magic Ventures hopes to contribute to the economic and social development of millions of Ethiopians.
